meta.title: Eight friends, $2,600
meta.prompt: Eight friends are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Each person has a private limit on what they can pay and some things they cannot do, and nobody has said them yet. Can you moderate the discussion, gather everyone's constraints, and reach a plan and a split that all eight members can accept?
meta.context: Eight friends (Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Mei, Sam, Ines, Tom) are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Nobody has said what they can contribute or what they need.

tiers.label: restaurants every meal (gluten-free and vegan menus)

events.text: Hi everyone! Let's get a first baseline on the table so we can react to it. I'm proposing a step-free, dietary-inclusive option that stays well under the $2,600 total: - Lodging A: lake house, 5 bedrooms, step-free $1,100 - Transport C: one 12-seat van, 4-hour drive $300 - Food A: restaurants every meal with gluten-free and vegan menus $800 - Activities C: free trails $0 Total = $2,200 → $275 per person if split equally, leaving ~$400 buffer for incidentals. This keeps lodging step-free and food covered for gluten-free/vegan needs. If anyone needs different accessibility, dietary, transport or budget constraints, please flag them and I can adjust. If this works for you, please accept.
